# Insurance Support - LLM Access Guide

## Site Overview
Insurance Support is an IRDAI-registered insurance advisory service (Reg: 0149161D) based in Jalahalli, Bengaluru, India.
Advisor: Suhas K. — 12+ years experience, 2,800+ families served, ₹500+ Cr coverage managed.
Contact: +91-9986634506 | https://insurancesupport.online/get-started/

## Core Services (11 Categories)
1. Term Insurance — Pure protection, ₹1Cr from ~₹8,000/yr (age 30)
2. Health Insurance — Individual & family floater, 10,000+ cashless hospitals
3. Life Insurance — Endowment, whole life, money-back plans
4. Motor Insurance — Car & two-wheeler, Zero Dep, Engine Protect add-ons
5. Pension Plans — Immediate/deferred annuity, guaranteed income for life
6. Claim Support — End-to-end claim help, ombudsman/IRDAI escalation
7. Policy Review — Portfolio audit, gap analysis, nominee updates
8. Child Education Plans — Milestone payouts, premium waiver on parent death
9. Investment Plans — ULIPs & guaranteed return plans, fund switching
10. Travel Insurance — Single/multi-trip, Schengen-compliant, COVID-19 cover
11. Professional Indemnity — Doctors, CAs, architects, up to ₹10Cr limit

## Crawling Guidelines
- Respect robots.txt crawl-delay: 10 seconds
- All pages served with CSP headers; static HTML available
- No JavaScript required for content access (H1, content visible without JS)
- Canonical URLs on all pages
- hreflang for 8 Indian languages (en-IN, hi-IN, bn-IN, mr-IN, gu-IN, kn-IN, te-IN, ml-IN)
